archive.zipValidation: all entries passed unzip integrity validation

licenseAndTerms.finding: The official archive contains its dataset README and data, but no LICENSE or separate dataset terms. The Apache-2.0 license in the supporting RuleTaker repository is recorded only as the software-repository license and is not silently asserted to cover the archive.
licenseAndTerms.currentUse: local research validation and evaluation without plaintext dataset redistribution
licenseAndTerms.remainingAction: Request or locate an explicit archive-specific dataset-license statement from AI2 before redistributing source rows or derived plaintext examples.

cachePolicy: The complete immutable ZIP and complete extracted tree are retained under the ignored training cache. Sampling affects only evaluation cost and never deletes source rows.
citation: Peter Clark, Oyvind Tafjord, and Kyle Richardson. ProofWriter: Generating Implications, Proofs, and Abductive Statements over Natural Language. Findings of ACL-IJCNLP 2021.
